- **Publish destination** — the GitHub repository `namastex888/fde-station-apt` (`channel/publish.sh:52` — `REPO_SLUG` default), suite `stable` (line 61 — `SUITE`), so packages are pushed to `dists/stable/` and `pool/` in that repo's default branch (`main`, wired via `git remote add origin` at line 166).

- **Distribution index location** — rooted at `$CHANNEL_DIR` (default `$HOME/.local/share/fde-station-apt`, line 53), with subdirectories `dists/$SUITE` (line 175 — `DIST_DIR`), `dists/$SUITE/$COMPONENT/binary-$ARCH` (line 176 — `IDX_DIR` holding `Packages`, `Packages.gz`), and `pool/$COMPONENT` (line 177 — `POOL_DIR` holding `.deb` files).
